title: FUJITSU Supercomputer PRIMEHPC FX1000: An HPC System Opening Up an AI and Exascale Era
version: First edition, 12 November 2019, as shown on p. 9

passages.locator: P. 7, TofuD overview, 6D mesh/torus network and Six RDMA engines
passages.note: Fujitsu explicitly traces TofuD to Tofu2 for FX100 and describes changes for dense systems and fault tolerance. It describes six RDMA engines in TofuD compared with four in K and Tofu2 and identifies use in Fugaku.
